facts.business: Jhandewalas Foods Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of food products, including ghee, under the Naman brand, with a legacy of 125 years and a network of over 11,000 retail stores and 500 distributors across India.

auditor.name: Jain Chowdhary & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-provisioning of interest on credit facilities from Axis Bank and Acme Resources Pvt. Ltd. classified as NPA. Emphasis of matters: (i) Rs. 5.76 crore of immovable assets (out of Rs. 5.92 crore) lack proper title deeds in the company's name; (ii) Company status on MCA portal shows 'Under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP)' per NCLT order dated 04.07.2025, stayed by NCLAT order dated 15.07.2025, with material uncertainty on going concern.

key_risks: Non-provisioning of interest on NPA accounts from Axis Bank and Acme Resources Pvt. Ltd.
Majority of immovable assets (Rs. 5.76 crore) lack proper title deeds in company's name
Company admitted under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) by NCLT order dated 04.07.2025, though stayed by NCLAT
Material uncertainty on going concern due to pending CIRP proceedings and NCLAT appeal
Legal dispute with Param Dairy Limited regarding supply of under-quality raw materials
